name: MosaicOS Pixel 7 Build (Android 17)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      DEVICE_NAME:
        description: "Device codename"
        required: true
        default: "panther"
        type: string
      PRODUCT_NAME:
        description: "Lunch target"
        required: true
        default: "lineage_panther-bp4a-user"
        type: string
      BUILD_COMMAND:
        description: "Build command"
        required: true
        default: "m bacon"
        type: string
      MANIFEST_BRANCH:
        description: "Mosaic-OS/platform_manifest branch to build from (Android 17 = \"17\")."
        required: true
        default: "17"
        type: string
      FORCE_RESYNC:
        description: "Force-reset every project to remote state (slower, discards any local changes/dirty checkouts). Leave 'no' for normal incremental syncs that only touch missing/changed projects."
        required: true
        default: "no"
        type: choice
        options:
          - "no"
          - "yes"
      CLEAN_BUILD:
        description: "Clean build? Warning: this is slower."
        required: true
        default: "no"
        type: choice
        options:
          - "no"
          - "yes"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: mosaicos-panther-build
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build MosaicOS - Pixel 7 (Android 17)
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 99999
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout workflow repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # IMPORTANT: the AOSP tree (repo init/sync output, ccache, out/, etc.)
          # lives in this same workspace directory on the self-hosted runner.
          # actions/checkout defaults to clean: true, which runs
          # `git clean -ffdx` + `git reset --hard` and will delete all of that
          # untracked source before every run. Disable it so only this
          # workflow repo's own tracked files are touched.
          clean: false

      - name: Show runner information
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " MosaicOS ARM64 Build Runner"
          echo "=============================================="
          echo "Hostname : $(hostname)"
          echo "User     : $(whoami)"
          echo "Arch     : $(uname -m)"
          echo "Kernel   : $(uname -r)"
          echo
          echo "OS:"
          if [ -f /etc/os-release ]; then
            cat /etc/os-release
          fi
          echo
          echo "CPU:"
          nproc --all
          echo
          echo "Memory:"
          free -h
          echo
          echo "Disk:"
          df -h
          echo
          echo "=============================================="
          

      - name: Install Android build dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

          REQUIRED_CMDS="adb bc bison gcc g++ ccache curl flex gperf convert git git-lfs gpg lz4 lzop python3 pip3 rsync schedtool mksquashfs unzip xsltproc zip"
          MISSING=""
          for cmd in ${REQUIRED_CMDS}; do
            command -v "${cmd}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || MISSING="${MISSING} ${cmd}"
          done

          if [ -z "${MISSING}" ]; then
            echo "=============================================="
            echo " All required build tools are already present."
            echo " Skipping apt-get entirely (no root/sudo needed)."
            echo "=============================================="
          else
            echo "Missing tools:${MISSING}"
            if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] && ! apt-get update >/tmp/apt_probe.log 2>&1; then
              echo "=============================================="
              echo " ERROR: apt-get needs elevated privileges here,"
              echo " and this step is intentionally not using sudo"
              echo " (sudo can hang waiting for a password on an"
              echo " unattended/remote run)."
              echo "=============================================="
              echo "Probe output:"
              cat /tmp/apt_probe.log
              echo
              echo "Fix options:"
              echo "  1) Run the runner service as root, or"
              echo "  2) Grant the runner user passwordless sudo for apt-get"
              echo "     (visudo: '<user> ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/apt-get')"
              echo "  3) Pre-install the missing tools once manually, then this"
              echo "     step will skip straight through on future runs."
              exit 1
            fi
            apt-get update
            apt-get install -y \
              adb bc bison build-essential ccache curl flex g++ git git-lfs gnupg gperf imagemagick libelf-dev libncurses-dev libssl-dev libxml2-utils lz4 lzop python3 python3-pip python3-venv rsync schedtool squashfs-tools unzip xsltproc zip zlib1g-dev
            echo
            echo "Installing additional tools when available..."
            for package in libncurses5-dev pngcrush; do
              if apt-cache show "${package}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                apt-get install -y "${package}" || true
              else
                echo "Skipping unavailable package: ${package}"
              fi
            done
          fi

          echo
          echo "Java check:"
          if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            java -version || true
          else
            echo "System Java not installed."
            echo "Android's prebuilts/JDK will be used after source sync."
          fi
          echo
          echo "Git LFS:"
          git lfs install --skip-repo

      - name: Install repo tool
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          mkdir -p "${HOME}/bin"
          curl -fsSL https://storage.googleapis.com/git-repo-downloads/repo -o "${HOME}/bin/repo"
          chmod +x "${HOME}/bin/repo"
          echo "${HOME}/bin" >> "${GITHUB_PATH}"
          export PATH="${HOME}/bin:${PATH}"
          echo
          echo "Repo version:"
          repo --version

      - name: Configure git
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          git config --global user.name "${GITHUB_ACTOR}"
          git config --global user.email "${GITHUB_ACTOR_ID}+${GITHUB_ACTOR}@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --global color.ui false
          git config --global protocol.version 2
          git config --global http.postBuffer 524288000
          git config --global http.maxRequestBuffer 100M
          git config --global core.compression 0
          git config --global fetch.parallel 8
          echo
          echo "Git configuration:"
          git config --global --list

      - name: Initialize MosaicOS
        shell: bash
        env:
          MANIFEST_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.MANIFEST_BRANCH }}
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " Initializing MosaicOS (Android 17 / ${MANIFEST_BRANCH})"
          echo "=============================================="
          repo init -u https://github.com/Mosaic-OS/platform_manifest.git -b "${MANIFEST_BRANCH}" --git-lfs

      - name: Install Pixel 7 manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          mkdir -p .repo/local_manifests
          cat > .repo/local_manifests/pixel7.xml <<'EOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
          <manifest>
            <!--
              As of the Android 17 / LineageOS 24 (lineage-24.0) cycle, LineageOS
              merged the panther (Pixel 7) and cheetah (Pixel 7 Pro) device trees
              into a single repo: android_device_google_pantah. The old
              android_device_google_panther repo is now just an empty stub that
              points here, so it is intentionally not synced below.
              Vendor blobs, however, are still split per-device under
              TheMuppets/proprietary_vendor_google_panther, not pantah.
            -->
            <project
              name="LineageOS/android_device_google_pantah"
              path="device/google/pantah"
              revision="lineage-24.0"
              clone-depth="1" />
            <project
              name="LineageOS/android_device_google_gs201"
              path="device/google/gs201"
              revision="lineage-24.0"
              clone-depth="1" />
            <project
              name="TheMuppets/proprietary_vendor_google_panther"
              path="vendor/google/panther"
              revision="lineage-24.0"
              clone-depth="1" />
          </manifest>
          EOF
          echo "Pixel 7 manifest:"
          cat .repo/local_manifests/pixel7.xml
          echo
          echo "Validating XML..."
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          ET.parse(".repo/local_manifests/pixel7.xml")
          print("Manifest XML is valid.")
          PY

      - name: Sync required device and kernel projects
        shell: bash
        timeout-minutes: 240
        env:
          FORCE_RESYNC: ${{ inputs.FORCE_RESYNC }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CPU="$(nproc --all)"
          if [ "${CPU}" -le 2 ]; then
            SYNC_JOBS="${CPU}"
          elif [ "${CPU}" -le 4 ]; then
            SYNC_JOBS=4
          else
            SYNC_JOBS="${CPU}"
          fi

          # Keep the existing Android source checkout untouched. Only sync the
          # Pixel 7 device configuration, vendor blobs, kernel, and modules
          # needed to make `source build/envsetup.sh` and `lunch` usable.
          REQUIRED_PROJECTS=(
            "device/google/pantah"
            "device/google/gs201"
            "vendor/google/panther"
          )

          # breakfast may generate roomservice.xml with the exact kernel and
          # google-modules project paths for this branch/device. Do not sync
          # the entire manifest; append only those required dependency paths.
          source build/envsetup.sh
          breakfast "${{ inputs.DEVICE_NAME }}" || true

          if [ -f .repo/local_manifests/roomservice.xml ]; then
            echo "roomservice manifest:"
            cat .repo/local_manifests/roomservice.xml
            while IFS= read -r path; do
              case "${path}" in
                kernel/google/*|device/google/*kernel*|hardware/google/*|vendor/google/*)
                  REQUIRED_PROJECTS+=("${path}")
                  ;;
              esac
            done < <(python3 - <<'PY'
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          root = ET.parse('.repo/local_manifests/roomservice.xml').getroot()
          for project in root.findall('project'):
              path = project.get('path')
              if path:
                  print(path)
          PY
          )
          else
            echo "No roomservice manifest was generated; syncing declared Pixel 7 projects only."
          fi

          # Remove duplicates while preserving the order in which paths were
          # discovered, then request repo sync for those paths only.
          mapfile -t REQUIRED_PROJECTS < <(printf '%s\n' "${REQUIRED_PROJECTS[@]}" | awk 'NF && !seen[$0]++')
          echo "CPU count : ${CPU}"
          echo "Sync jobs : ${SYNC_JOBS}"
          echo "Projects to sync:"
          printf '  - %s\n' "${REQUIRED_PROJECTS[@]}"

          SYNC_FLAGS=(-c --no-clone-bundle --no-tags --optimized-fetch --retry-fetches=5 -j"${SYNC_JOBS}")
          if [ "${FORCE_RESYNC}" = "yes" ]; then
            echo "FORCE_RESYNC=yes: force-syncing only the required projects."
            SYNC_FLAGS+=(--force-sync)
          else
            echo "FORCE_RESYNC=no: incrementally syncing only required projects."
          fi

          repo sync "${SYNC_FLAGS[@]}" "${REQUIRED_PROJECTS[@]}"

      - name: Verify Android build environment prerequisites
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " Verifying required Android source paths"
          echo "=============================================="
          test -d build
          test -d device/google/pantah
          test -d device/google/gs201
          test -d vendor/google/panther
          echo "Required source, device, and vendor directories are present."

      - name: Verify source tree
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " Verifying source tree"
          echo "=============================================="
          test -d build
          test -d device/google/pantah
          test -d device/google/gs201
          test -d vendor/google/panther
          echo
          echo "Required directories found."
          echo
          echo "Device tree:"
          ls -la device/google/pantah | head -30
          echo
          echo "Vendor tree:"
          ls -la vendor/google/panther | head -30

      - name: Setup Android build environment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " Android build environment"
          echo "=============================================="
          source build/envsetup.sh
          # Normalize product name for lunch if needed
          lunch "${{ inputs.PRODUCT_NAME }}"

      - name: Optional clean build
        if: ${{ inputs.CLEAN_BUILD == 'yes' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " Cleaning build output"
          echo "=============================================="
          rm -rf out
          echo "Build output cleaned."

      - name: Build ROM
        shell: bash
        timeout-minutes: 720
        env:
          DEVICE_NAME: ${{ inputs.DEVICE_NAME }}
          PRODUCT_NAME: ${{ inputs.PRODUCT_NAME }}
          BUILD_COMMAND: ${{ inputs.BUILD_COMMAND }}
          MANIFEST_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.MANIFEST_BRANCH }}
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " MosaicOS"
          echo " Pixel 7 / Panther (pantah)"
          echo " Android 17 / ${MANIFEST_BRANCH}"
          echo " Debian ARM64"
          echo "=============================================="
          echo "Device : ${DEVICE_NAME}"
          echo "Product: ${PRODUCT_NAME}"
          echo "Build  : ${BUILD_COMMAND}"
          echo
          echo "CPU:"
          nproc --all
          echo
          echo "Memory:"
          free -h
          echo
          echo "Disk:"
          df -h
          echo
          echo "=============================================="
          export BUILD_USERNAME="${GITHUB_ACTOR}"
          export BUILD_HOSTNAME="github-actions-arm64"
          source build/envsetup.sh
          # Normalize product name for lunch if needed
          lunch "${PRODUCT_NAME}"
          echo
          echo "Build variables:"
          echo "DEVICE_NAME=${DEVICE_NAME}"
          echo "PRODUCT_NAME=${PRODUCT_NAME}"
          echo "BUILD_COMMAND=${BUILD_COMMAND}"
          echo "MANIFEST_BRANCH=${MANIFEST_BRANCH}"
          echo
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " Starting ROM build"
          echo "=============================================="
          bash -c "${BUILD_COMMAND}"

      - name: Locate build artifacts
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " Build artifacts"
          echo "=============================================="
          OUT_DIR="out/target/product/${DEVICE_NAME}"
          echo "Output directory:"
          echo "${OUT_DIR}"
          if [ -d "${OUT_DIR}" ]; then
            echo
            echo "Files:"
            find "${OUT_DIR}" -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name "*.zip" -o -name "*.img" -o -name "*.apk" -o -name "*.json" -o -name "*.txt" \) -print || true
            echo
            echo "Output directory size:"
            du -sh "${OUT_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true
          else
            echo "Output directory does not exist."
          fi

      - name: Upload ROM artifacts
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mosaicos-${{ inputs.DEVICE_NAME }}-android17-build
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            out/target/product/${{ inputs.DEVICE_NAME }}/*.zip
            out/target/product/${{ inputs.DEVICE_NAME }}/*.img
            out/target/product/${{ inputs.DEVICE_NAME }}/*boot*.img
            out/target/product/${{ inputs.DEVICE_NAME }}/*vendor*.img
            out/target/product/${{ inputs.DEVICE_NAME }}/*.json

      - name: Show final disk usage
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "=============================================="
          echo " Final disk usage"
          echo "=============================================="
          df -h
